sam: Observing a recurring pattern in apac1: warm-pool prefill completes and we get NIC rx drops + HBM evictions. Short requests p99 jumps after fill.

marta: Any quick metrics?

sam: Ran `fleet-insight query --region apac1 --since 15m --metrics p99_tail_ms,nic_rx_drop,hbm_evictions,alloc_requeues`. Snippet: p99_tail_ms 45ms->160ms, nic_rx_drop 0->220/s, hbm_evictions 0->12/min, alloc_requeues 1->18.

ops-bot: Alert prefill-rx-drop-high at 6123570005 :warning:

owen: Likely bursty completion traffic from warmers overwhelming top-of-rack proxies. Two mitigation paths: pace completion acks in warm-agent or spread prefill across racks.

tara: Short term do (A) pace final ack with jitter 100-500ms. Longer term (B) add allocator knobs: ror_spread_factor and max_warmers_per_tor.

sam: Pushing warm-agent patch to add randomized 250ms backoff before final RPC and rate-limit final RPCs to 50/s per rack. Canary on leaf-4.

marta: Add dashboard `prefill_ack_rate_by_rack` and alert if any rack >60/s during fills.

owen: I'll run synthetic canary to validate HBM reduction.

sam: Initial canary: p99 down to ~70ms, nic_rx_drop ~0, hbm_evictions -70%.

marta: Note cost tradeoff: spreading across racks/AZs increases cross-rack egress ~3-8% for affinity workloads. Include in runbook.

ops-bot: Incident window recorded for 6123570000.

sam: Actions: sam push patch & metrics (ETA 1h); marta create dashboards (ETA 45m); tara draft allocator proposal + cost appendix (ETA 24h); owen run synth canary (ETA 2h).

owen: Will test paced-ack throughput impact.

sam: Will post perf dump and PR when live. :rocket:
